name: telegram-personal-assistant

scripts.coverage: node tests/resetCoverage.mjs && vitest run && node tests/generateCoverageReport.mjs
scripts.coverage:after: npm run coverage && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('coverage/coverage-summary.json', 'after.json')" && node tests/compareCoverage.mjs before.json after.json

author: Pablo Bottinelli
description: Asistente personal modular por Telegram para centralizar finanzas, recordatorios, automatizaciones de uso cotidiano y otras utilidades.
